story_anchor: A Vietnamese viewer is guided from a familiar experience of anger toward the Buddhist practice of observing emotion without immediately acting on it. The video distinguishes canonical principles from modern application, illustrates the teaching through an anonymous everyday situation, and ends with a concrete way to pause before reacting.
